# Run lead's corrections to the glosser's output (aeneid-089)

- maeonidae: dropped the odd "Greek -ae; also voc. pl." and the over-explained lemma; nom. pl. of Maeonidēs, the Etruscans as Lydians.
- partiri: dropped "also pass. inf. of partiō" (no such use here, and the deponent covers the form).
- capto: broadened (existing entry gave only m. dat./abl.; 783 *tempore capto* is n. abl.).
- arceat: the glosser said it was missing from novel-forms.json; it is there (102 forms), so the entry stands as a novel entry.
- aënis: existing entry (aēneus, f. abl. pl.) already covers 770; no change.
